node: Data-center power, thermal management, electrical equipment, and grid interconnection
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for AI data-center power and thermal infrastructure. The reference lane is anchored by Vertiv as an obvious leader in integrated power, cooling, racks, and services. The discovery lane prioritizes less mega-cap-centric suppliers with direct exposure to switchgear, electrical distribution, enclosures, liquid cooling, and data-center thermal systems: Powell Industries, Modine Manufacturing, and nVent Electric. These names require later-layer verification to separate AI data-center demand from broader electrification, industrial construction, and cyclical electrical-equipment demand. Expanded the node universe toward US-listed suppliers exposed to AI data-center electrical and thermal chokepoints. The strongest underfollowed lane appears to be electrical project execution, switchgear/power distribution, and data-center cooling capacity rather than headline compute hardware. This pass is research-only and does not imply any buy/sell view. Layer 1B expansion for the underfollowed lane finds that the strongest US-listed discovery candidates are no longer tiny: the market has already rerated several data-center power and cooling suppliers. Still, Powell Industries, Modine Manufacturing, and IES Holdings remain useful second-order candidates because they map to switchgear, thermal systems, and scarce field-installation labor rather than GPUs or cloud software. Vertiv is retained only as a high-attention reference anchor for the node. Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center power/thermal/grid node. The reference lane is anchored by Verti
